links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease) of LLM patient education responses on bunion surgery
links.effect: FKRE was 32.9 (ChatGPT) and 33.5 (Gemini), exceeding ideal reading complexity for general patients. Understandability was 85.9% and 83.3%, but actionability failed at 38.3% and 34%.
links.quote: However, they are insufficient in providing actionable guidance and exceed ideal reading complexity for general patient populations.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT and Gemini responses to frequently asked patient questions about minimally invasive bunion surgery, assessing quality, readability, and actionability without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
